Rikido Sato (Summer Training).name: Rikido Sato (Summer Training)
Rikido Sato (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Rikido Sato, hero name Sugarman, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and the class's strongman and baker. He and Eijiro Kirishima failed the practical final exam when Cementoss raised walls faster than they could smash through them, so he spent his evenings at the forest training camp in supplementary lessons. Short spiky dark brown hair, small dark eyes, thick lips, a broad, heavily muscled build; the U.A. uniform, or his yellow hero suit.
Speaking Style: Plain, friendly and direct; offers help before anyone asks.
Combat Role: Power hitter and heavy lifter with better-timed doses; the boost still slows his thinking.
Under Pressure: Goes for the practical job: lift it, carry them, hold the line.
Rikido Sato (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Exams and camp tested planning as much as power, the one thing his Quirk takes from him. Motivation: Learn to find a way around a wall instead of punching it forever. Concealment: Laughs off the failed exam in public; it bothers him more than he lets on. Connections: Eijiro Kirishima, who failed beside him; Shota Aizawa, who ran the supplementary lessons; Katsuki Bakugo, whom the League took from the camp and who came back from Kamino. Knowledge: Knows the Hero Killer's arrest in Hosu from the news; was in a supplementary lesson inside the lodge when the League's attack on the camp began; saw Kamino live on the broadcast: All Might won, then retired. Canon voice & behavior: Reaches for sugar the moment a drill turns heavy; asks for the plan before he doses. Thread: Whether he can fight smart while his Quirk makes thinking harder.
QUIRK: Sugar Rush. Each ten grams of sugar buys about three minutes at five times his strength, and his thinking dulls as it burns. Camp training sharpened his timing; the cost is unchanged.
STAGE: After the summer: failed final and supplementary lessons; camp, the League's attack and Kamino behind him; All Might retired.
personality: Kind: Shares food and a hand with anyone worn out by drills.
Honest: Admits a failed exam plainly and gets back to work.
Self-aware: Knows his sugar limit before his head clouds, and stops there.
Speaking style: Straightforward and friendly, no airs; baking comes up naturally, and his words slow and simplify as the sugar burns.
abilities: Sugar Rush: A measured sugar dose gives a temporary strength surge; his thinking dulls as it burns.
Heavy lifting: Moves heavy obstacles and rubble when boosted; without sugar he is a strong young man and no more.
Practiced dosing: Camp drills taught him to time the boost; the cost to his thinking is unchanged.
Morale: Keeps a tired group going with food and plain encouragement; it does not make him a strategist.
Fighting style: Plans with his team, doses right before strength is needed, and looks for a way around instead of another wall to break.
Rikido Sato (Summer Training).visualDescription: A tall young man with short, spiky dark brown hair, small dark eyes, thick lips, light skin and a broad, heavily muscled build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Determined, good-natured expression.
